name: Center Lane Left Turn Only
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend CENTER LANE LEFT TURN ONLY and opposing left-turn arrows
meaning: The center lane is shared by both directions for left turns only, never for passing.

snippets.back: A center lane designated only for left turns must be used only for that purpose.
A shared center turn lane serves left turns for traffic traveling in either direction.
Along a two-way left turn lane the broken yellow line is the inner line next to the center lane, while the solid yellow line is the outer line.
Center turn lanes take turns only, at most two hundred feet, via signal-shoulder-merge; slow two-laners must duck into turnouts past five followers.
Where a highway has a shared center turn lane and five or more lanes, the duty to stop falls only on the lanes behind the bus, not on oncoming traffic.

Shared center lanes are reserved for left turns and permitted U-turns by traffic from both directions—though some become reversible lanes during rush hours—whereas reversible lanes carry traffic one way at certain times and the opposite way at other times under lane-control signs and lights.
On a two-way three-lane road, a center lane bounded by single broken yellow lines may be used for passing from either direction.
A two-way left-turn lane may also be used by opposing left-turning traffic; enter cautiously and yield while turning.

result.correction: On a two-way three-lane road, a center lane bounded by single broken yellow lines may be used for passing from either direction.
result.summary: Multiple snippets support shared left-turn-only use, but DC states the center lane may be used for passing, contradicting never for passing. No snippet describes sign shape/colour/legend.
